groups.activity: earn a Death Mark, then kill (Shadow/Protector) Stalker
groups.meta: 5.87% War BP, 2.77% Broken War BP per kill

rows.label: Broken War Blueprint
rows.note: 2.77% per kill (Shadow Stalker); untradeable, needed for the foundry step below

conditions: Only the killing blow earns the mark: a squadmate finishing the boss gets it, not you.
Excluded bosses grant no mark: Captain Vor (Mercury), Corrupted Vor, Ropalolyst, Zealoid Prelate, The Fragmented, H-09 Efervon Tank.
Spawn chance is 1.5% + 0.5% per marked squad member (2% solo, 3.5% with a full marked squad), arriving 30-280s into the mission; the window closes around 5 minutes.
He cannot spawn in Assassination or Syndicate nodes, Sorties, Archon Hunts, Arenas, free roam, Archwing, relays/dojos, Albrecht's Laboratories, Höllvania or Dark Refractory missions.
Warframes below rank 10 block the spawn entirely.
Base pre-quest Stalker drops neither blueprint: only Shadow Stalker (after The Second Dream) or Protector Stalker (after Jade Shadows) do.
War requires MR 10 to build; a newer player can earn the blueprint long before they can craft it.
bonuses: Run the Hyena Pack (Psamathe, Neptune) for marks: each Hyena can grant its own.
The Sergeant (Iliad, Phobos) is the fastest single-boss mark: Volt, Gauss or Titania clear it in well under a minute.
Public squads raise spawn chance to 3.5% and are free.
Both blueprints can drop from the same kill, so this one farm loop covers War and its Broken War ingredient together.

disclosures.title: the maths behind the reputation
disclosures.body: Expect around 17 kills for War's own blueprint, and more for the rarer Broken War one, stacked on a 2-3.5% spawn chance per mission: realistically measured in playtime, not sessions. Reported outcomes range from a first-kill drop to 1,000-3,000+ hours without one.

disclosures.title: a disputed post-patch buff
disclosures.body: Community threads report Update 36 (Jade Shadows) raising both blueprints to 5.87%. Current wiki-sourced data still lists Broken War at 2.77% from Shadow Stalker specifically: treat 5.87% as optimistic until confirmed.

disclosures.title: beacons force the spawn, not the drop
disclosures.body: Stalker Beacons (125,000 cr + 200 Ducats, Baro Ki'Teer, rotating stock) guarantee an encounter but still roll the same odds per kill.

disclosures.title: don't lose the loot
disclosures.body: Stalker often dies or flees out of sight: ask the squad for a waypoint to his body. Host migration or a bugged lobby can eat a rare drop, so note it down when it happens.

conditions: Never feed in The Second Dream's free copy: its Catalyst doesn't transfer, and Broken War outperforms War for most builds. Always craft a dedicated second copy to sacrifice.
Don't sell a spare Broken War Blueprint; it's untradeable and this recipe's only other source.
